'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|What's up, warrior. I've been talking to my nephew about some video game where you shoot demons. I thought I'd give him a little present. Anyway, here's the task: get me a double-barrelled shotgun like in that game, and make it look real nasty! Oh, and make the barrel shorter.}}

==Requirements==
* This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

==Objectives==
* Modify an [[MP-43-1C 12ga double-barrel shotgun|MP-43-1C shotgun]] to comply with the given specifications

==Rewards==
* +3,000 [[EXP]]
* 80,000 Roubles
** 84,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 92,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|It really is a beast! Even I'm now interested in seeing this game...}}

In this quest you must hand over an [[MP-43-1C 12ga double-barrel shotgun]] modified with the shorter [[MP-43-1C 12ga 510mm barrel]] to [[Prapor]]. Both items can be bought from [[Jaeger]] LL1.

==Trivia==
This questline is a reference to the game "Doom II: Hell on Earth" which features the "Super shotgun", a sawed-off, double-barreled shotgun.
